disputes.safe: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation while you still can, and keep a manual Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
disputes.title: Positive Mental Attitude — 18 meditations, and does the Chapter 1 balcony count?

versions.label: Version A — 18 at 10 spots; balcony counts
versions.text: 18 meditations across 10 named spots. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation raises the counter by 1 even though it is not marked as a Meditation Spot.

versions.label: Version B — 100% needs only 15 of 18
versions.text: The 100% completion checklist needs 15 of 18 meditations, so three can be skipped for 100% — but the trophy itself still needs all 18.

versions.label: Version C — the arithmetic that settles it
versions.text: Eight spots count twice (Jason + Lucia), the balcony counts once and the Ascent counts once: 8 x 2 + 1 + 1 = 18.

disputes.safe: Do Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass icon appears in Chapter 3, and save first.
disputes.title: Strangers & Freaks — how many strands count, and can one be missed?

versions.label: Version A — only 4 strands confirmed
versions.text: Only four strands are confirmed as counting: Kirk (3 quests), Kyle (3), Yago (4) and Pilot Pete (5). More strangers may still be undiscovered.

versions.label: Version B — the Yago race can lock you out
versions.text: Skipping Race Against Yago can lock you out of Yago's missions. Do it while the hourglass icon shows, and save beforehand.

versions.label: Version C — a single-source warning
versions.text: One source warns that stranger chains sit behind story-progress windows. No second source confirms the warning, so it is shown, not settled.

disputes.safe: Turn the Criminal Profile notifications on and play normally; the count climbs on its own.
disputes.title: Actions Speak Louder — what is one of the 500 actions?

versions.label: Version A — 500 actions
versions.text: GTABase counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, and most players earn this without trying.

versions.label: Version B — the [500] is editorial, not Rockstar's
versions.text: The 500 figure was added in square brackets by an editorial list, not by Rockstar's own description. The count itself is still reported the same way.

versions.label: Version C — 500, with profile tiers
versions.text: PowerPyx also reports 500, shows the count by clicking the trophy, and lists the tiers Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (permanent).

versions.agreed: All sides agree the Irredeemable status is permanent. No source explains what exactly counts as one action.
versions.label: What is agreed
versions.text: Irredeemable is permanent. What counts as one action is not defined anywhere.

disputes.safe: Try the reported method; if it does not pop, wait for a second confirmation before grinding it.
disputes.title: In The Beginning… — reported method vs not confirmed

versions.label: Version A — a method is reported
versions.text: PowerPyx reports: Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, drink it standing beside the bar.

versions.label: Version B — not confirmed
versions.text: GTABase still writes that the exact steps are not confirmed yet. Treat the method as reported, awaiting a second confirmation.

disputes.safe: Try the reported method; if it does not pop, wait for a second confirmation before grinding it.
disputes.title: Capital Offense — reported method vs not confirmed

versions.label: Version A — a method is reported
versions.text: PowerPyx reports: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and smash out through the window, with the Key Cloner from Chapter 3.

versions.label: Version B — not confirmed
versions.text: GTABase still writes that the exact steps are not confirmed yet. Treat the method as reported, awaiting a second confirmation.

disputes.safe: Try the reported method; if it does not pop, wait for a second confirmation before grinding it.
disputes.title: The Truth Is Out There — reported method vs not confirmed

versions.label: Version A — a method is reported
versions.text: PowerPyx reports a UFO easter egg: the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 02:00, alone.

versions.label: Version B — not confirmed
versions.text: GTABase still writes that the exact steps are not confirmed yet. Treat the method as reported, awaiting a second confirmation.

disputes.safe: Chase 42 golds across the two ranges; do not trust either range count as a fact.
disputes.title: The Shootist — 12 ranges or 14?

versions.label: Version A — 12 ranges
versions.text: Three sources count 12 shooting range courses holding the 42 gold medals.

versions.label: Version B — 14 challenges
versions.text: FullSweep counts 14 challenges with 3 golds each. That would also total 42 golds.

versions.agreed: 42 golds, 2 ranges, split Griffin 18 / Rodgers Ranch 24.
versions.label: What is agreed
versions.text: 42 golds across the Griffin and Rodgers Ranch ranges, split 18 and 24.

disputes.safe: Call it the final mission, never Chapter 4 or Chapter 5, until the sources agree.
disputes.title: Final mission — Chapter 4 or Chapter 5?

versions.label: Version A — Chapter 4
versions.text: PowerPyx places the final mission Starting From Zero in Chapter 4.

versions.label: Version B — Chapter 5
versions.text: GTABase places Operation Savage Glory (Snow Storm) in Chapter 5, and other lists call the finale Chapter 5 too.

disputes.safe: Do not plan around any single story-mission total; the sources do not agree on one.
disputes.title: Story missions — 91, 94 or 118?

versions.label: Version A — 91
versions.text: Game-Checklists counts 91 story missions in its text.

versions.label: Version B — 94
versions.text: The same site's checklist counts 94.

versions.label: Version C — 118
versions.text: Another tracker counts 118. This guide never states one total as fact.

disputes.safe: Budget 200+ hours; the long tail is collectibles and 100% cleanup.
disputes.title: Platinum time — 200, 250 or 300 hours?

versions.label: Version A — about 200 hours
versions.text: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer estimate around 200 hours to the platinum.

versions.label: Version B — 250 to 300+ hours
versions.text: Push Square estimates 300 hours or more. The gap is the cleanup tail, not the story.

disputes.safe: Treat Strangers & Freaks as possibly missable and the balcony meditation as a watch; nothing else is flagged.
disputes.title: How many trophies can be missed — 0, 1 or 2?

versions.label: Version A — 1 possibly missable
versions.text: Five sources count one possibly missable trophy.

versions.label: Version B — 2
versions.text: Some lists add Catch Me If You Can as a second possible miss.

versions.label: Version C — 0
versions.text: Push Square records no missable trophy at all.
